name: pstaender/uptimecheck
description: Very simple uptime check for shared hosting

scripts-descriptions.serve: Starts the web interface on http://localhost:8000 for development
scripts-descriptions.cron: Runs the checks once, printing every result
scripts-descriptions.test-mail: Sends a test notification mail to the configured recipients
scripts-descriptions.test-mail-down: Sends a test of the notification mail for down sites
scripts-descriptions.test-mail-up: Sends a test of the notification mail for sites back up
scripts-descriptions.hash-password: Prints a password hash for auth.password: composer hash-password -- 'your-password'
scripts-descriptions.test: Runs the test suite (needs a local postgres)
scripts-descriptions.build: Creates dist/uptimecheck-<version>.zip with the files for the web hosting
